failure_modes.name: Entity_Coreference_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim refers to 'the University of Texas System, which Lorene Rogers was president of in the 1970's' but passage [1] states 'Lorene Lane Rogers...served as the president of the University of Texas at Austin in the 1970s.' The solver in summary_1 and summary_2 correctly identifies these as 'distinct entities' but the claim treats them as coreferent. The passages show University of Texas at Austin is 'the flagship institution of the University of Texas System' (passage from hop 2), not the System itself.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query 3: 'When was the University of Texas System founded, and how does it differ organizationally from the University of Texas at Austin? Who served as head football coach at the University of Texas at Austin during the 1970s when Lorene Rogers was president? Did Ralph Fielding serve as head football coach at the University of Texas at Austin, and if so, during what years?' This query bundles multiple distinct retrieval targets (founding date, organizational structure, 1970s coaches, Ralph Fielding's tenure) into compound yes/no questions rather than focused entity queries.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 explicitly identifies the missing entity: 'Most critically, Ralph Fielding is not mentioned in any provided passage' and 'The claim requires additional documentation to verify the specific roles.' Query 3 targets this gap: 'Who served as head football coach at the University of Texas at Austin during the 1970s when Lorene Rogers was president?' Despite this well-formed chase, hop 3 returns only coaches from other decades (1957: Darrell Royal, 1990-91: David McWilliams, 1994-95: John Mackovic, 1998-2000: Mack Brown) with no information about the 1970s coaching staff—a corpus coverage gap.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: After hop 1, the solver extensively analyzes passages [3]-[7] about coaches at other Texas institutions (Jim Wright at Wichita State/Texas A&M, James Earl Rudder at Texas A&M System, Jim Carlen at West Virginia/Texas Tech/South Carolina, Jim Pittman at Tulane/TCU, and 1970 Idaho Vandals) which have no relevance to verifying claims about University of Texas at Austin. Summary_1 reasoning devotes attention to these tangential coaching records rather than focusing on the core verification gaps.
